# Attach Convex projects (`attach_convex_projects`)

MCP tool `repository_convex_attachProjects` · scope `access_provider_connections` · write

Re-reads every selected Convex project and exact repository code location before writing any
attachment. A project that another Samebase app attaches is rejected. The final Samebase mutation is
atomic: either every selected project and confirmed location is attached or none are. Convex
projects and GitHub files are not modified.

## Arguments

- `repositoryId` (string, required): Samebase repository ID returned by
  repository_dashboard_getUserRepositories.
- `projects` (array, required): One or more project id and code location selections from
  repository_convex_discoverProjects. Use only projects with attachment attachable.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "convexProjectIds": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["convexProjectIds"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
